description: Model-agnostic ASR slot of the on-device voice bundle. libelizainference (built with LLAMA_BUILD_PARAKEET=ON) serves eliza_inference_asr_* and asr_stream_* from whatever sits under <bundle>/asr/: a parakeet-tdt GGUF (one file) or the Qwen3-ASR text + mmproj pair (two files). `backend` names which; `asr/` holds only that backend's files. Changing the ASR model means changing only this record and restaging; scripts/paradee-runtime.ts admits exactly these files and refuses any other file under asr/.
model: Phonon-2 (Parakeet-TDT 0.6B, five-value weights), the upstream mobile-voice@1.4.2 default ASR with canonical positive-zero mel weights
attribution: Phonon-2 by Fermion Research, CC-BY-4.0, derived from NVIDIA parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (CC-BY-4.0). Fermion's NOTICE ships in the bundle (notices/phonon-2/NOTICE) and in the app's third-party notices; the GGUF also carries it as parakeet.notice.
licenseFlags: Training audio listed in the Phonon-2 NOTICE includes CHiME-6 (CC-BY-SA-4.0) and SPGISpeech (Kensho terms). Flagged for review, not a build blocker.
install: APK assets (assets/paradee-voice/v1/asr/), copied to app storage and SHA-256 verified on first use by ai.eliza.voice.VoiceAssets.install

files.source: Converted by elizaOS/llama.cpp@5c5d6163c81cfc2f85ce3c12f10adbec5ae165cd tools/parakeet/convert_phonon2_to_gguf.py --archive phonon-2.bps.tar.zst --output phonon-2-fv5.gguf --verify from huggingface.co/FermionResearch/Phonon-2@7e153e4054c0a10db6d47d6fff5c062d4c77c154 (archive sha256 98125795b6dda72f5c6eee9ba33d19815df65dcb18b50a357bf9f73c9935309e); byte-identical macOS ARM64 and Linux x86_64 outputs with Python 3.12.11 / NumPy 2.5.4, equal to the mobile-voice@1.4.2 catalog pin (status unpublished: built locally, never downloaded)
